+"""Camera-guided controller for the single friction_qa episode.
+
+Uses only rcb_client observations, robot facts, and joint-position commands.
+All observations and command batches are retained beside this script.
+"""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+
+def connect():
+    r = Robot()
+    (OUT / 'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(r.spec(), indent=2))
+    return r
+
+def record(res, label):
+    res.save(str(OUT / label))
+    (OUT / 'latest.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
+    print(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
+
+def observe(label='initial', seconds=0.0):
+    r = connect()
+    res = r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, include_depth=True, video='frames')
+    record(res, label)
+    return res
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    observe(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'initial',
+            float(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 0.0)
